hook: Musk leads three of the highest-profile companies building toward AI-driven and space-based infrastructure. He founded xAI in 2023, has served as CEO of Tesla since 2008, and founded SpaceX in 2002. In 2025 xAI acquired X Corp, and in 2026 SpaceX acquired xAI, consolidating his AI, electric vehicle, and rocket ventures under increasingly interlinked ownership.
name: Elon Musk
moniker: Founder and CEO of xAI, CEO of Tesla, Founder of SpaceX

primary.name: Elon Musk biography, Tesla Investor Relations

secondary.name: CNBC, Elon Musk launches his new company, xAI
CNBC, Elon Musk says xAI has acquired X

timeline.impact: Establishes the launch vehicle and spacecraft company he continues to lead.

timeline.event: Becomes Chief Executive Officer of Tesla in October 2008.
timeline.impact: Takes operating control of the electric vehicle maker, per Tesla's investor relations disclosures.

timeline.event: Founds xAI and publicly launches the company on July 12, 2023.
timeline.impact: Enters the AI foundation model market with a stated mission to accelerate human scientific discovery.

timeline.event: xAI acquires X Corp in an all-stock deal announced March 28, 2025, valuing X at $33 billion.
timeline.impact: Brings the social media platform under the same ownership as the AI company.

timeline.event: SpaceX acquires xAI in an all-stock transaction announced February 2, 2026, valuing the combined entity at $1.25 trillion.
timeline.impact: xAI becomes SpaceX's AI division ahead of SpaceX's planned IPO.

quick_facts: Founder and CEO of xAI, launched publicly on July 12, 2023
Chief Executive Officer of Tesla since October 2008 and a Tesla board member since April 2004
xAI acquired X Corp in an all-stock deal announced March 28, 2025
SpaceX acquired xAI in an all-stock transaction announced February 2, 2026, with xAI becoming SpaceX's AI division
